name: imgcodec
description: xi.imgcodec — the first official LIB plugin (capability plane, docs/new_gen/14). NO data plane: it never emits and nothing routes to it; on create it registers the capabilities xi.jpeg.encode (image + quality -> JPEG bytes, content-keyed dedup memo cache: one encode serves every consumer) and xi.image.decode (bytes -> image; stb_image format set — host_api->read_image_file's designated v12 eviction target). Consumers resolve get_interface("xi.cap", 1) and call by name; versioning rides in the request pack ($v, $probe).
_lib_doc: lib plugin marker (informational, doc 14 pilot): a capability provider, not a pipeline stage — do not wire it as an input/output of anything; create one instance and let consumers reach it by capability name through the host funnel.
_autoload_doc: V3 machine-level autoload ELIGIBILITY (doc 14 / doc 19 V3): marks this lib provider as safe to instantiate once at service boot under a machine owner, so xi.image.decode / xi.jpeg.encode are available WITHOUT any project declaring a per-instance (clears E1's second cause, doc 06 §6). ELIGIBILITY ONLY — the host autoloads eligible providers only when the DEPLOYMENT opts in (backend flag `--autoload-lib` / env XINSP2_AUTOLOAD_LIB), so the default (unset) deployment is byte-unchanged and this never silently alters the WS wire (e.g. expose's E2 preview, which keys off xi.jpeg.encode availability). A project that DOES declare an imgcodec instance takes precedence: it displaces the machine provider for the life of that project (no double-registration), reinstated on project close.
_reentrant_doc: capability handlers are invoked by the host funnel WITHOUT per-instance serialization (the provider thread-safety contract); the control surface (exchange/set_def) may also run concurrently — everything inside is mutex/atomic-guarded.
_on_fault_doc: a codec whose handler faulted should stop serving (quarantine) rather than keep answering from possibly-corrupt state; consumers see the established -3 and the operator re-enables by re-committing config.

params.name: quality
params.doc: JPEG quality 1..100 used when a request carries no 'quality' entry

params.name: cache_max
params.doc: dedup memo cache capacity (entries, FIFO rotation)

capabilities.name: xi.jpeg.encode
capabilities.doc: Pack in: image 'image' (1/3/4ch 8-bit), i64 'quality' (opt), i64 '$v' (opt, default 1) | bool '$probe'. Pack out: bin 'jpeg', i64 'cache_hit', i64 'encodes', i64 'hits'. Contract failure -> $fault pack.

capabilities.name: xi.image.decode
capabilities.doc: Pack in: bin 'data' (PNG/JPEG/BMP/TGA/GIF/PSD/HDR/PIC), '$v'/'$probe' as above. Pack out: image 'image', i64 w/h/c. Contract failure -> $fault pack.

exchange.doc: -> {encodes, hits, decodes, cache_entries, registered} — encodes vs hits is the dedup proof counter
